description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target ranged physical attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, Lv.2 En-Fire Stack, Lv.2 En-Earth Stack, Lv.2 En-Wind Stack or Lv.2 En-Poison Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison Damage +20%, Physical Casting Speed x1.1 & chases a Machinist ability with [Imperil Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison to all targets & Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison Ability Damage +30% for 2 turns to party] or [Prismatic Damage +20% & Machinist Damage +30% for 2 turns to party] with at least 0/4 Machinists (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Machinist, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Chain Saw+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses; Equalizer+: 1.2s CT
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
